verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants drive the account programmatically: exploring setup, building and deploying workflows, running simulations, testing tools, diagnosing tickets and auditing knowledge bases. It also publishes an llms.txt index pointing to those docs. However, the evidence shows no conventional documented public API (REST/GraphQL reference, auth, endpoints, SDKs), so programmatic control is only shown through an MCP and assistant layer. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API reference (endpoints, auth, rate limits), SDKs or clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
